Name: Daisy
Author: mulderitsme
Description:
This is a simple retexture of cat #3, inspired by my cat, Daisy. [img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]  I hope you enjoy! I'm brand new to modding this game, kindly let me know if there are any issues.

[i][size=5]Installation[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]Instructions:[/size][/i]
[list]
[*]Make sure you are running the game through SMAPI and have the latest version of Content Patcher installed
[*]Download and extract the file, and drop it into your mods folder.
[/list]
[size=5][i]Uninstall:[/i][/size]
[list]
[*]remove the folder from your mods folder
[/list]
[size=5][i][img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]Requirements:[/i][/size] 
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[/list]
